parts.t: The Morgan, Welcome to the original SHOWROOM - 3 Bed 3 Bath Georgian style townhouse built by Mosaic, in the heart of Morgan Crossing in South Surrey. This main floor with an open layout features 10'ft height ceilings and a large kitchen with stainless steel appliances. BONUS custom wood built-ins in the dining room & living room! Well-maintained the complex. Close to all local amenities: gym, parks, schools, groceries, banks, Grandview Aquatic Centre, 30+ restaurants, Outlet, Walmart, Home Depot, Superstore & more. School catchment: Edgewood Elementary, Grandview Heights Secondary, and private Southridge are just steps away.
